prerequisites: Engineering knowledge from a preceding Bachelor's degree program

learning_outcomes.text: Analyze, structure, plan, implement, and critically evaluate a complex engineering research or development project independently as part of a team.
Systematically question and refine even incomplete or diffuse tasks, and convert them into verifiable project goals.
Justifiably select and apply suitable methods from research, development, and project management.
Consistently define and document project structure, work packages, time planning, resources, and responsibilities.
Document technical, organizational, and potentially experimental results comprehensibly.
Present and defend project results in written and oral form in an audience-appropriate manner.

Successfully handle complex tasks from research and industrial development under realistic conditions (e.g., uncertainty, conflicting objectives, resource limitations) and be prepared for further project, research, or master's theses.

syllabus_topics: Analysis and clarification of the task and derivation of project goals
Selection and application of suitable development, research, or project management methods
Structuring the project into work packages including time and resource planning
Processing technical questions (e.g., conception, modeling, simulation, experiment, implementation)
Documentation of the procedure and results
Presentation and discussion of project results

assessment_methods.method: Written elaboration in the form of a project report (study paper)

assessment_rules: Assessment is based on practical project work, a written project report (study paper), and an oral presentation of project results. All assessment components relate to the same project and evaluate both the outcome and the methodological approach.
bibliography: dependent on the respective project task
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Maschinenbau (M.Sc.)
